`alpheus` talks to the cluster with your kubeconfig and has no server or login of its own.
Flags can come before or after the arguments, with one dash or two.
A command that fails exits with 1 and says what you can do; a wrong command line exits with 2.

Every command takes these flags:

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--kubeconfig` | The kubeconfig file (default: `KUBECONFIG` or `~/.kube/config`) |
| `--context` | The kubeconfig context (default: the current one) |
| `-n`, `--namespace` | The namespace (default: the context's) |
| `-o`, `--output` | `json` or `yaml`, for scripts (default: text) |

## alpheus run

Create a StreamRun from a file.

```
alpheus run -f flow.yaml
```

Reads the file strictly, so a misspelt field is an error, and runs the controller's checks of the steps and edges first. An image without a digest gives a warning, since the controller refuses it unless it runs with `-allow-tags`.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-f string` | the flow file, or - for stdin |

## alpheus get

Show runs, or one run's status.

```
alpheus get [run]
```

Without a run, lists the runs in the namespace, or in all namespaces with `-A`. With one, shows its steps, replicas, edges with their lag, results and where to fetch them, and error logs.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-A` | runs in all namespaces |

## alpheus watch

Follow a run's status live, with the lag of each edge.

```
alpheus watch <run>
```

Prints the whole status at each change, as text or, with `-o json`, one object per line. It ends when the run finishes, with exit code 0 only when it succeeded, so a script can wait for a run with it.

## alpheus logs

Show the logs of a run's containers.

```
alpheus logs <run> [step]
```

Shows the component's log, or the agent's with `-c agent`, of every step or one.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-c string` | the container: component or agent (default "component") |
| `-f` | short for --follow |
| `--follow` | keep printing new lines until the pods end |
| `--tail int` | only the last lines of each container; -1 means all (default -1) |

## alpheus cancel

Cancel a run.

```
alpheus cancel <run>
```

Sets `spec.cancel`. The controller stops the pods; chunks and results are cleaned up as for a finished run.

## alpheus chunks

Show the manifest of an edge or a result.

```
alpheus chunks <run> <edge>
```

Reads the manifests of an edge, such as `filter-sum`, or of a result, `<step>.<output>`, with the keys in the run's storage Secret. When `spec.storage.endpoint` is only reachable inside the cluster, pass the address you reach it by with `--endpoint`.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--ca-file string` | CA bundle for the storage endpoint |
| `--endpoint string` | the S3 endpoint as seen from here, when spec.storage.endpoint is only reachable in the cluster |

## alpheus validate

Check a flow file without creating it.

```
alpheus validate -f flow.yaml
```

Runs the same checks as `run` and has the API server check the fields and rules with a dry run, without creating anything. `--local` needs no cluster and skips the server's checks.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-f string` | the flow file, or - for stdin |
| `--local` | only the checks that need no cluster; skips the CRD's schema and rules |

## alpheus results

Delete results whose TTL has run out (GO-99).

```
alpheus results gc
```

Lists the results in a bucket and deletes those whose `resultsTTL` has run out since the run finished. Results whose StreamRun is gone are kept until their TTL runs out, unless you pass `--orphans`; results with `resultsTTL` 0 are never deleted. It asks before deleting, unless you pass `--yes`.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--bucket string` | the bucket with the results: spec.storage.resultsBucket, or bucket |
| `--ca-file string` | CA bundle for the endpoint |
| `--dry-run` | only show what would be deleted |
| `--endpoint string` | the S3 endpoint, as in spec.storage.endpoint |
| `--orphans` | also delete results whose StreamRun is gone, before their TTL runs out |
| `--region string` | the bucket's region, as in spec.storage.region |
| `--secret string` | the Secret in -n with keys that can delete in the bucket (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) |
| `--yes` | delete without asking |

## alpheus version

Show the CLI, controller and CRD versions.

```
alpheus version
```

Shows the CLI's version, and the controller's and the CRD's when the cluster can be read.
